title: Six-case transfer test of some-core tree certificates
status: Protocol fixed before calculating these six outcomes; internally recorded, not externally preregistered

cases.rationale: Mostly coprime speeds, without the earlier fixed slow core
Nearby speeds around multiples of sixteen; additive relations
Recurrence relations and a broad speed range; not a novelty claim for Fibonacci results
Quadratic structure with mixed common factors
Several prime-power chains and mixed repetition scales
Additive recurrence broken at the last speed

selection.cores: All 35 three-element subsets of the seven labelled nonreference runners
selection.windows: Every complete CLOSED core-safe connected component in [0,1], including singleton components
selection.blockers: Strict distance less than 1/8; keep endpoint membership in all containment tests
selection.reduction: Remove empty blockers; quotient equal nonempty sets; retain the lowest original runner index in each inclusion-maximal class
selection.bound: Window length minus retained single durations plus maximum spanning-tree pair-overlap weight; zero retained means length, one retained means length minus its duration
selection.ties: Among positive-length windows: greatest bound, then fewest retained blockers, then greatest width, then lexicographically smallest numerical core tuple, then earliest left endpoint
selection.independence: Do not use actual allowed sets or actual uncovered duration in selection keys
selection.fallback: If no positive bound, test all sorted distinct core-component endpoints against all seven constraints; absence of a valid endpoint means inconclusive

measurements: Complete exact allowed set at reference 0, positive duration, isolated points, and a directly checked witness
For every core/component: optimal full and reduced tree bounds, actual duration, strict containment map, vanished blockers and retained representatives
Per-core counts/extrema and reproducible digests of every complete component; selected certificate with all moments and retained relationships
Count positive actual windows missed by trees; measure optimal-tree slack using induced active-subgraph component counts
Independent event-based reconstruction and separately computed spanning-tree optimum
Relational structure of selected certificates, including whether useful certificates require containment
hypothesis: For eight distinct integer velocities at a selected reference, strict lonely time implies a positive tree certificate on some complete safe component of some three-runner core
falsifier: A strict configuration with no positive bound across all 35 cores
adaptive_limit: If a falsifier occurs, inspect at most one failed configuration with stronger pair inequalities; label this follow-up separately. Otherwise investigate the six fixed cases structurally without adding speed configurations.
limits: Selected reference 0 only; exact rational/integer arithmetic; no all-reference scan, broad parameter search, retuned cases, outside contact, paid compute, or theorem/novelty claim. All six have a speed divisible by eight so time 1/8 fails. This does not assert the cases are hard, random, independent, or representative.
